instructions:
We are creating individual SVG character illustrations for one human bandit family in a dark fantasy tactical RPG. Establish this visual style.
STYLE: Expressive hand-crafted vector illustration with strong silhouettes, angular shapes, elegant curves and restrained cel shading. Finished game asset, readable on a small character card. Dangerous, cunning outlaws with worn equipment made from leather, wood and salvaged metal.
FAMILY APPEARANCE: Adult humans with expressive faces and varied builds. Natural human skin colors and human proportions.
PALETTE: Worn brown leather, charcoal outlines, muted ochre cloth, rust-orange metal and bone highlights.
COMPOSITION: Exactly one full-body character in three-quarter view on a square transparent canvas with generous margins. Entire head, feet, weapons and accessories visible. Purposeful pose communicating the role. Lighting from upper left.
SVG: Clean editable paths, layered solid shapes and limited shading. Avoid raster images, blur, excessive gradients and tiny texture marks. No background, scenery, frame, text or platform. Keep the face complete and readable; simplify minor equipment decoration if needed.
prompt: A human bandit thug wearing a worn leather jerkin and patched clothing. A crude axe in one hand and a small wooden shield in the other. Surly expression and a cautious fighting stance.
